'''Ameesa Darys''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] Inquisitor of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]]. A [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] and later a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], upon the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], she followed in her master's footsteps and turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]].

==Biography==
Ameesa Darys was the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]]. Eventually, she became a Jedi Knight herself and Jerec became a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].<ref name="The Dark Forces Saga" />

Upon the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Darys followed in her former master's footsteps, falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and joining the Imperial [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]].<ref name="CSWE" /> On [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], Inquisitor Darys' agents captured [[Lagan Ismaren|Lagan]] and [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]]. When they were brought before Darys, the ruthless Inquisitor ignited her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in Lagan's heart and let him die before his sister's eyes.<ref name="TEP" /> Darys then turned Roganda Ismaren to the dark side.<ref name="CSWE" />

In [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], Inquisitor Darys, along with [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Laddinare Torbin|Torbin]] and Inquisitor [[Antinnis Tremayne]], encountered [[Arden Lyn]], an ancient [[Dark side adept/Legends|dark side adept]] reawakened from a millennia long slumber. Lyn killed Darys and fought off<ref name="Warfare" /> and seriously injured Tremayne before Torbin was able to [[Sai cha/Legends|remove]] Lyn's right arm with his lightsaber and disarm her.<ref name="TEP" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Abel G. Peña]] created Ameesa Darys for his debut article, "[[The Emperor's Pawns]]," but did not create the character's name. The name "Ameesa Darys" originated in editing,<ref name="JCF1" /> apparently in reference to the name of comedian [[Amy Sedaris]].<ref name="JCF2">{{JCFCite|url=posts/23364317|board=Literature|thread=Daily Hyperspace SW Comic Strip Adventures Discussion-"Rookies" & "Evasive Action: End Game"|user=[[Pablo Hidalgo|Pabawan]]|date=2006-03-08|time=8:56 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200328171716/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/daily-hyperspace-sw-comic-strip-adventures-discussion-rookies-evasive-action-end-game.16431027/page-26}}</ref> Originally, Peña intended Darys to be a male, but he later changed his mind when writing [[The Dark Forces Saga]] in order for the character to better serve as a counterpart to Jerec's master, [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]].<ref name="JCF1" />
